description:
SBI code index

Returns all SBI codes from the local dataset. Optionally filter by `level` (1–5)
and/or `parent_code` to retrieve only the direct children of a given SBI code.

Levels: 1 = sectie (A–U), 2 = afdeling, 3 = groep, 4 = klasse, 5 = subklasse.

Source: [CBS Standaard Bedrijfsindeling 2025](https://www.cbs.nl/sbi)

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: cbs.sbi
